# apple_alternative_distribution_package (Resource)

Creates the alternative distribution package of an App Store version, which an alternative marketplace or a website downloads to distribute the app in the EU. A version has one package: the resource creates it, or manages the existing one. Read its downloads with `data.apple_alternative_distribution_package_versions`. App Store Connect can't delete a package, so destroying the resource leaves it. Import it by the App Store version's ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_alternative_distribution_package" "example" {
  app_store_version_id = apple_app_store_version.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_store_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`. Changing it creates a package for the other version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the alternative distribution package.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_alternative_distribution_package.example
  identity = {
    app_store_version_id = "0b2d4f6a-8c1e-4a3b-9d5f-1e2a3b4c5d6f"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_store_version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_alternative_distribution_package.example 0b2d4f6a-8c1e-4a3b-9d5f-1e2a3b4c5d6f
```
